items.title: fix(build): regenerate uv.lock so psycopg-pool ships in the image
items.body:
## Root cause of the #599 deploy failure
`uv.lock` is committed, and the Dockerfile installs deps from it (`uv export --frozen`), **not** from pyproject. #599 added `psycopg[binary,pool]` to pyproject but didn't regenerate the lock — which had **zero** `psycopg-pool`. So the image shipped without the module; Django's pool config raised `ImproperlyConfigured: Error loading psycopg_pool module` on every DB-touching request (including `/api/health`), the new tasks never became healthy, and ECS rolled back at *"ServicesStable: max attempts exceeded"* (confirmed in CloudWatch).

Local tests stayed green because the venv installs from **pyproject** (`uv pip install -e .[dev]`), not the lock — a lock/pyproject divergence that nothing caught.

## Fix
`uv lock` → adds `psycopg-pool 3.3.1`. Verified the image's exact path now emits it:
```
$ uv export --frozen --no-dev --no-emit-project | grep psycopg-pool
psycopg-pool==3.3.1
```
Minimal diff (one dep added). With this, the pooled `production.py` (from #599) loads and the deploy should stabilize.
